name: Rusk
description: Adult human fighter available for controlled practice at Lists; quilted training coat, sword and round shield.

practice_bout.format: First three clean controlled touches; stop on touch, no injury resolution unless someone abandons control

prepared_counter.triggering_attack: low axe cut to forward leg
prepared_counter.rule: CFI defender substitutes selected attacker special effect with own automatic effect on trigger; no free attack

dropped_weapon.name: Practice sword
dropped_weapon.status: retrieved during stop after second touch

practice_control.reason: Controlled touch practice, no damaging follow-through; restore real modifier when bout ends

extras.tourney_goal: Win a guild contract through Single Combat
extras.observed_halla: Halla won a controlled practice bout 3-1, saluted and shook hands, thanked Rusk, then introduced himself as Halla from the Forge Quarter.

scheduled_marda_job.known_terms: Halla said Marda needs us for guard work this afternoon, couple gold; Rusk accepts two gold

extras.current_loadout: prone on arena sand; longsword dropped nearby, left shield arm unusable

street_encounter.action: Delay behind sword and shield at boarding gap
street_encounter.scope: First counter against this threat used; cannot react again to the identical threat. Retains remaining action for a fresh threat.

passive_block.expires: when shield used to attack or actively parry
passive_block.established: Re-established free after missed shield attack

street_encounter.position: Ashore beside the boarding gap after stepping in to support Halla
street_encounter.status: resolved; Dragon Knights withdrew; no injuries; boats and cargo secure

bera_guard_job.result: boats, crews and cargo delivered safely

tournament_injury.treatment: Tournament surgeon Healing75 rolled41 success: urgent treatment stabilises Major left-arm wound, immediate fatal risk arrested. No HP restored; arm remains disabled. Attendants transfer Rusk to healers' tent.

extras.tournament_result: lost to Halla by marshal stoppage round2
extras.luck_policy: PC-only campaign rule: NPCs have no Luck pool or Luck rank bonuses; never spend Luck for NPC rerolls, reversals or damage mitigation.

actor_notes: Speech short and easy, plain fighting vocabulary, one question at a time. Wants a useful practice partner before tomorrow registration. Friendly but takes the bout seriously. Does not read opponent motives or skill from appearance. Opens with name and first-three-touch offer. Fights behind round shield, measures distance before committing, varies tactics after an exchange. No forced boasting or cruel humiliation.
